items.question: Which Annex III item covers AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, such as filtering job applications?
items.author: seed
items.note: Annex III point 4 (employment, workers management and access to self-employment).

items.question: Which Annex III item covers AI systems used by or on behalf of public authorities to evaluate the eligibility of natural persons for essential public assistance benefits and services, including healthcare services?
items.author: seed
items.note: Annex III point 5(a); the parent item eu-ai-act:annex-iii:point-5 is an acceptable coarser citation but the gold id is the precise one.

items.question: Under Article 9(1) of the EU AI Act, what must be established in relation to high-risk AI systems?

gold.answer_text: A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems.

items.author: seed
items.note: Answerable verbatim from eu-ai-act:article-9:paragraph-1 text; the article node is the gold citation.

items.question: Under Article 14(1) of the EU AI Act, what must the design of high-risk AI systems enable natural persons to do during the period in which the systems are in use?

gold.answer_text: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, so that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.
